Customs Act 1969: Section 18, sub-section (2) of this Act empowers the Government to issue notifications and amend existing ones regarding regulatory duties through consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Board acts as the primary advisory body to the Government for the issuance and amendment of regulatory duty notifications.
S.R.O. 223-AIN/2019: This existing notification is being formally amended to replace the specific table of items and their corresponding regulatory duty rates.
TABLE: This table provides a comprehensive list of H.S. Codes, their descriptions, and the applicable Regulatory Duty (RD) rates for various imported goods, including agricultural products, industrial chemicals, construction materials, and motor vehicle components.
